=== wildcard and none
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  none => 0
  _ => 1
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [none => 0] [_ => 1])

=== literal patterns
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  1 => "one"
  2.5 => "half"
  500 lb => "w"
  $10 => "m"
  18% => "p"
  "EXP" => "t"
  @2026-10-22 => "d"
  true => "b"
  _ => "?"
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [1 => (text "one")] [2.5 => (text "half")] [500[lb] => (text "w")] [$10 => (text "m")] [18% => (text "p")] [(text "EXP") => (text "t")] [@2026-10-22 => (text "d")] [true => (text "b")] [_ => (text "?")])

=== negative literal patterns
tariff "t"
let a = match t {
  -5 °C => 1
  -$5 => 2
  _ => 3
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match t [(neg 5[°C]) => 1] [(neg $5) => 2] [_ => 3])

=== range patterns
tariff "t"
let a = match w {
  ..500 lb => 1
  500 lb..2_000 lb => 2
  2_000 lb..=5_000 lb => 3
  5_000 lb.. => 4
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match w [(.. _ 500[lb]) => 1] [(.. 500[lb] 2000[lb]) => 2] [(..= 2000[lb] 5000[lb]) => 3] [(.. 5000[lb] _) => 4])

=== variant patterns
tariff "t"
let a = match stop.kind {
  Pickup => 1
  StopKind.Delivery => 2
  SplitPickup | SplitDelivery => 3
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match (. stop kind) [Pickup => 1] [StopKind::Delivery => 2] [(| SplitPickup SplitDelivery) => 3])

=== capitals variants
tariff "t"
let a = match region {
  NE | SW => 1
  _ => 2
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match region [(| NE SW) => 1] [_ => 2])

=== binding pattern with a guard
tariff "t"
let a = match n {
  x if x > 3 => x
  _ => 0
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match n [(bind x) if (> x 3) => x] [_ => 0])

=== a guard that ends in a name right before the arrow
tariff "t"
let a = match flag {
  x if x => 1
  _ => 0
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match flag [(bind x) if x => 1] [_ => 0])

=== a guard that ends in a field, a call or parentheses before the arrow
tariff "t"
let a = match stop {
  s if s.appointment => 1
  s if ready(s) => 2
  s if (late) => 3
  s if s.items.any(i => i.hazmat) => 4
  _ => 0
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match stop [(bind s) if (. s appointment) => 1] [(bind s) if (call ready s) => 2] [(bind s) if (paren late) => 3] [(bind s) if (call (. (. s items) any) (lambda (i) (. i hazmat))) => 4] [_ => 0])

=== a lambda written as a guard's value is still misplaced inside it
tariff "t"
let a = match n {
  x if [y => 1] => 1
  _ => 0
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match n [(bind x) if (list (lambda (y) 1)) => 1] [_ => 0])
! misplaced 37..43 A lambda like `x => …` can only be passed to a list method, like `stops.count(s => s.appointment)`

=== record patterns
tariff "t"
let a = match stop {
  { kind: Delivery, appointment: true } => 1
  { kind: Pickup } => 2
  _ => 3
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match stop [(record kind:Delivery appointment:true) => 1] [(record kind:Pickup) => 2] [_ => 3])

=== nested record patterns
tariff "t"
let a = match s {
  { window: { start: none } } => 1
  _ => 2
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match s [(record window:(record start:none)) => 1] [_ => 2])

=== or of literals and ranges
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  1 | 2 | 5..9 => "small"
  _ => "large"
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [(| 1 2 (.. 5 9)) => (text "small")] [_ => (text "large")])

=== text pattern with interpolation
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  "{y}" => 1
  _ => 2
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [(text y) => 1] [_ => 2])
! syntax 31..36 Text in a pattern can't interpolate values

=== range pattern with no ends
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  .. => 1
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [(.. _ _) => 1])
! syntax 31..33 A range needs a start, an end or both

=== missing pattern
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  => 1
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [? => 1])
! syntax 28..28 Expected a pattern: a value, a range, a variant, `none` or `_`

=== empty record pattern
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  { } => 1
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [(record) => 1])
! syntax 31..34 A record pattern needs at least one field

=== arm without an arrow
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  A 1
  B => 2
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [A => ?] [B => 2])
! syntax 33..34 Expected `=>` and what this arm gives

=== a block in a match expression
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  A => { note "x" }
  _ => 2
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [A => ?] [_ => 2])
! syntax 36..48 A block of statements can't be used as a value here; a record is written `'{' name: value '}'`

=== keyword field names in record patterns
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  { in: 1 } => 1
  _ => 2
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [(record in:1) => 1] [_ => 2])

=== match statement arms on one line each
tariff "t"
match x {
  A => note "a"
  B | C => {}
}
---
tariff "t"
match x
  arm A =>
    note (text "a")
  arm (| B C) =>

=== two arms on one line
tariff "t"
let a = match x {
  A => 1 B => 2
}
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x [A => 1])
! syntax 38..39 Each statement goes on its own line; start a new line before `B`

=== match without braces
tariff "t"
let a = match x
---
tariff "t"
let a = (match x)
! syntax 26..26 Expected the `match` arms in braces after the value
